description: WireGuard, BIRD 2 and RouterOS 7 configs for a DN42 peering, following the wiki conventions. Inputs – our_asn: Your AS number; peer_asn: Peer AS number; peer_ll6: Peer link-local IPv6; our_ll6: Your link-local IPv6 (optional); peer_ipv4: Peer tunnel IPv4 (optional); our_ipv4: Your DN42 IPv4 (optional); endpoint: Peer endpoint host:port (optional); peer_pubkey: Peer WireGuard public key (optional); enh: Session type. Results include plain-English findings with fixes and a shareable link.
name: dn42_peering_config
title: DN42 peering config generator
